headings.title: Hearing on motion to dissolve attachment and plaintiff burden of proof
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to hear evidence on motion to dissolve attachment with burden on plaintiff to prove attachment grounds and order sustaining or overruling the motion.

headings.title: Trial on merits, record requirement, and supersedeas appeal bond
headings.reviewNote: Requires merits trial on the record incorporating attachment finding in judgment, permits appeal after new-trial motion, and gives appellant's appeal bond supersedeas effect preserving plaintiff's attachment.

headings.title: Liability of plaintiff and sureties on bond upon adverse outcome
headings.reviewNote: Holds plaintiff and sureties liable on their bond for all attachment-occasioned damages and costs if plaintiff fails to appeal, appeal is dismissed, or adverse judgment is affirmed.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all 3 subsections, statutory history, and effective date 1-01-87; dissolution-motion hearing and plaintiff burden, merits judgment/appeal/supersedeas bond, and plaintiff/surety bond liability verified.

headings.title: Survival of attachment and lien upon defendant's death
headings.reviewNote: Prevents dismissal of attachment action or destruction of lien upon defendant's death after levy or garnishee summons (except on debts not due), proceeding to final judgment as if living.

headings.title: Joinder of personal representative, appointed defense counsel, and unmatured debts
headings.reviewNote: Requires joinder of executor/administrator or court-appointed defense attorney taxed as costs, and grants plaintiff on a debt not due an election to proceed against administrator or present a probate claim.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections, statutory history, and effective date 1-02-79; tightened subsection 1 title and verified survival of attachment/lien (except debts not due), representative joinder, appointed counsel, and plaintiff election on unmatured debts.

headings.title: Judicial determination of priorities among multiple attachment plaintiffs
headings.reviewNote: Permits court where same property is attached by multiple plaintiffs against the same defendant to adjudicate priorities, validity, and good faith and dissolve or postpone attachments.

headings.title: Transfer of coordinate jurisdiction attachments to first-issuing court
headings.reviewNote: Requires transfer of coordinate-jurisdiction attachment cases to the court that issued the first writ of attachment for consolidated determination.

headings.title: Opposing plaintiff defense to prior attachments upon defendant default
headings.reviewNote: Permits an opposing plaintiff to assert defendant's defenses to prior attachments when defendant served by publication does not appear, without binding defendant personally or barring re-suit.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all 3 subsections, statutory history, and effective date 1-02-79; permissive priority adjudication among attaching plaintiffs, transfer to first-issuing coordinate court, and opposing-plaintiff defenses upon publication default verified.

headings.title: Third-party claim valuation and double-value indemnification bond
headings.reviewNote: Requires third-party claims to state property value, sets plaintiff indemnification bond at double that value, and directs officer appraisement if plaintiff objects to stated value.

headings.title: Conditions and sufficiency of indemnification bond
headings.reviewNote: Deems a bond with good and sufficient security an indemnification bond conditioned as under section 30 of the December 1, 1855 act to regulate executions (chapter 63, RSMo 1855).

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and statutory history; verified third-party claim valuation, double-value indemnification bond with appraisement on objection, and historical 1855 execution-bond condition reference.

headings.title: Bond required before paying proceeds in officer suits
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits court in a levy or sale suit against an officer or sureties (after notice) from ordering payment of sale proceeds unless entitled parties have given or forthwith give a section 521.850 bond.

headings.title: Permissive joinder of bonded indemnitor as defendant
headings.reviewNote: Permits court in its discretion to allow joinder of any person who gave an indemnification bond as a defendant in the officer suit.

headings.title: Officer recovery of paid money and damages
headings.reviewNote: Grants officer, sureties, and legal representatives a right to recover back money paid on the levy or sale and, if made by direction or authority of an interested person or agent, to recover damages paid.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all 3 subsections, statutory history, and effective date 1-02-79; tightened subsections 1 and 3 titles and removed unstated 'unlawful' wording from subsection 3 note.
